property_summary: SetMinSum remains callable as long as the contract is not Initialized: calling it twice with v1 then v2 always leaves MinSum()==v2 in the reference, whereas the mutant locks permanently after the first call so the second reverts and MinSum()==v1.
change_summary: Delete `locked_ = false;` from the modifier so the lock is never released, making any SetMinSum call after the first one revert and leaving MinSum unchanged.
